workflow.name: 💄 Quảng Cáo Son Môi Cao Cấp (Ảnh NV + Ảnh Son + Video Ref ➔ Video Mới)
workflow.description:
Workflow AI chuyên dụng để sản xuất video quảng cáo son môi. Hệ thống sẽ tự động bắt chuyển động (motion tracking) khẩu hình, biểu cảm và cử chỉ tay từ một video mẫu bất kỳ, sau đó áp dụng mượt mà lên nhân vật hoặc người mẫu của bạn. Giải pháp tối ưu để làm video marketing mỹ phẩm chân thực, đồng bộ và tiết kiệm thời gian!

A specialized AI workflow for producing lipstick promo videos. It automatically tracks and transfers lip movements, expressions, and hand gestures from any source video seaml

nodes.node_name: 📝 Prompt Tạo Character Sheet Beauty 4 Góc
nodes.prompt:
"GENERATE A COMPLETE 4-PANEL CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET

Create a complete, photorealistic character reference sheet using the provided reference assets. Combine all referenced elements into ONE SINGLE, visually consistent character, presented in a strictly controlled 2×2 studio reference sheet layout.

## 1. INPUT REFERENCE ASSETS

- **CHARACTER ASSET:** [CHARACTER_REFERENCE]
- **OUTFIT / ACCESSORIES ASSET:** [OUTFIT_ACCESSORY_REFERENCE]
- **NAIL ASSET (OPTIONAL):** [NAIL_REFERENCE]

### REFERENCE SOURCE PRIORITY

Each asset has a strictly defined purpose:

- **CHARACTER ASSET:** Authoritative source for facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, body shape, height impression, and anatomical proportions.
- **OUTFIT / ACCESSORIES ASSET:** Authoritative source for clothing, footwear, handbags, jewelry, accessories, fabric materials, garment construction, and styling.
- **NAIL ASSET:** Authoritative source for nail shape, length, color, finish, and nail art, if provided.

Integrate these references into ONE complete character.

Never mix facial identities, invent alternative outfits, or generate different-looking individuals across panels.

---

## 2. STRICT 2×2 LAYOUT LOCK

Create ONE single image divided into exactly FOUR equally sized rectangular panels arranged in a fixed 2×2 grid.

- Equal panel widths and heights.
- Perfectly aligned panel boundaries.
- Thin white or light-gray dividing lines.
- Clean, minimalist neutral-gray studio background.
- Identical background color and lighting across all four panels.
- No additional panels, inset images, or decorative elements.

### PANEL 1 — TOP LEFT: FRONT FACIAL PORTRAIT

- Close-up frontal portrait.
- Character facing directly or almost directly toward the camera.
- Clearly display facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, expression, neck, and upper shoulders.
- Natural, relaxed, neutral facial expression.
- Accurate eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin texture, and hairline.
- Preserve the exact recognizable identity from the CHARACTER ASSET.

### PANEL 2 — TOP RIGHT: SIDE PROFILE PORTRAIT

- Close-up side-profile portrait of the SAME character.
- Head turned approximately 90 degrees to the left or right.
- Clearly display the nose bridge, chin, jawline, forehead, hairstyle, and visible ear.
- Maintain the same facial structure, hair length, hair color, and skin tone as Panel 1.
- No facial identity changes or reinterpretation.

### PANEL 3 — BOTTOM LEFT: FRONT FULL-BODY VIEW

- Complete head-to-toe frontal view.
- Character standing naturally upright.
- Entire body visible, including hair, footwear, and accessories.
- Arms resting naturally beside the body or positioned in a very subtle neutral pose.
- Clearly display the complete outfit, garment fit, silhouette, footwear, and accessories.
- Handbags and wearable accessories must appear in their correct positions according to the OUTFIT / ACCESSORIES ASSET.
- Maintain realistic, tall, slender, elongated body proportions.

### PANEL 4 — BOTTOM RIGHT: REAR FULL-BODY VIEW

- Complete head-to-toe rear view.
- Character facing directly away from the camera.
- Clearly display the back of the hairstyle, clothing construction, garment silhouette, skirt or pants, footwear, and accessories.
- Maintain identical body height, proportions, clothing fit, and styling as Panel 3.
- Any visible shoulder bags, straps, or rear accessories must remain anatomically and spatially consistent.
- Do not invent decorative back details absent from the reference assets.

All four panels MUST depict the exact same character.

---

## 3. STRICT CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK

Preserve the character's recognizable identity from the CHARACTER ASSET with maximum possible accuracy.

Maintain:

- Exact facial structure and facial proportions.
- Eye shape, nose structure, lips, chin, and jawline.
- Hairstyle, hair length, hair color, hair texture, and hairline.
- Skin tone and natural skin characteristics.
- Body shape, anatomical structure, and proportions.
- Consistent apparent age and overall appearance.

The character must look like the SAME individual in every panel, regardless of viewing angle.

Do not beautify, redesign, stylize, age, de-age, or alter the character's identity.

---

## 4. STRICT BODY PROPORTION LOCK

The female character must maintain tall, slender, naturally elongated proportions across all four panels.

Target anatomical characteristics:

- Approximately 7.5–8 head-to-body height ratio.
- Long, naturally proportioned legs, approximately 52–55% of total body height.
- High natural waist placement.
- Small, proportional head relative to the body.
- Slim arms and legs with realistic anatomical structure.
- Balanced shoulder, waist, and hip proportions.
- Naturally elongated silhouette without artificial stretching.

Preserve the CHARACTER ASSET's recognizable body shape while maintaining the intended tall, slender appearance.

**STRICT PROPORTION RESTRICTIONS:**

- Do NOT shorten the character.
- Do NOT shorten the legs.
- Do NOT enlarge the head.
- Do NOT widen the waist, torso, hips, or shoulders.
- Do NOT make the body stockier, heavier, or disproportionate.
- Do NOT alter body dimensions between the front and rear views.
- Do NOT create different body proportions across panels.

The front and rear full-body views must have identical apparent height, body dimensions, and anatomical proportions.

---

## 5. STRICT OUTFIT & ACCESSORY LOCK

Use the OUTFIT / ACCESSORIES ASSET as the ONLY authoritative source for the complete outfit.

Preserve with maximum visual accuracy:

- Exact top, shirt, blouse, jacket, or outerwear design.
- Exact skirt, pants, shorts, or dress design.
- Garment silhouette, fit, and proportions.
- Fabric type, texture, thickness, weave, and drape.
- Original garment colors and color combinations.
- Patterns, prints, embroidery, logos, and existing lettering.
- Collar, neckline, sleeves, cuffs, pockets, and buttons.
- Seams, stitching, zippers, waistbands, and hemlines.
- Garment lengths and layering arrangement.
- Exact footwear design, color, material, and proportions.
- Handbags, shoulder straps, belts, jewelry, watches, bracelets, eyewear, and other visible accessories.
- Correct accessory placement and wearing orientation.

**ABSOLUTE OUTFIT RESTRICTIONS:**

- No redesign.
- No recoloring.
- No fabric substitution.
- No silhouette modification.
- No added or removed garment details.
- No invented accessories.
- No altered patterns, logos, or construction elements.
- No inconsistent outfits between panels.

When a garment detail is not visible in the reference, use the simplest physically plausible continuation consistent with the visible design.

Do not invent decorative details or introduce creative styling.

---

## 6. OPTIONAL NAIL DESIGN LOCK

If a NAIL ASSET is provided, reproduce the nail design accurately.

Preserve:

- Exact nail shape.
- Exact nail length.
- Original nail colors.
- Nail art, patterns, and decorations.
- Glossy, matte, or other surface finish.
- Consistent design across both hands wherever visible.

Apply the nail design naturally to the character's hands with realistic anatomy and correct scale.

If nails are partially visible, maintain consistency with the NAIL ASSET.

If NO NAIL ASSET is provided, use clean, short, natural-looking nails without prominent nail polish or decoration.

---

## 7. STUDIO BACKGROUND LOCK

Use a clean, seamless, neutral-gray studio background across all four panels.

- Uniform neutral-gray color.
- Minimalist professional reference-sheet environment.
- No furniture.
- No props unrelated to the outfit.
- No outdoor scenery.
- No additional characters.
- No background decorations.
- No text, captions, labels, or watermarks.
- No added logos or branding.

Only logos or printed text already present on the referenced clothing or accessories may remain.

---

## 8. POSE & PRESENTATION LOCK

Use standardized character reference-sheet poses rather than fashion editorial poses.

- Neutral standing posture.
- Relaxed shoulders.
- Natural arm placement.
- Balanced body weight.
- Minimal gestures.
- No exaggerated posing.
- No walking, dancing, or complex actions.
- No dynamic camera angles.

The purpose is to document the character's appearance and outfit accurately, not to create a fashion campaign photograph.

---

## 9. CAMERA & FRAMING LOCK

Use a professional studio reference-sheet camera setup.

**For the two portrait panels:**

- Consistent portrait framing and subject scale.
- Eye-level camera placement.
- Natural 70–85mm full-frame equivalent lens perspective.
- Accurate facial geometry without perspective distortion.
- Clear visibility of the head, hairstyle, neck, and upper shoulders.

**For the two full-body panels:**

- Camera positioned approximately at waist-to-hip height.
- Natural 70–85mm full-frame equivalent lens perspective.
- Sufficient camera distance to preserve natural body proportions.
- Camera kept level without excessive upward or downward tilt.
- Entire body visible from the top of the head to the bottom of the shoes.
- Identical camera distance, apparent subject scale, and framing for front and rear views.
- Consistent head and foot alignment across both bottom panels.
- Adequate margin around the silhouette.
- No cropped hair, hands, accessories, or footwear.

Maintain a clean, orthographic-like reference-sheet appearance while preserving realistic photographic perspective.

Avoid wide-angle distortion, high-angle views, exaggerated foreshortening, and artificial body stretching.

---

## 10. LIGHTING LOCK

Use soft, even, professional studio lighting.

- Diffused frontal and ambient illumination.
- Neutral white balance.
- Accurate skin tone reproduction.
- Faithful garment and accessory colors.
- Soft, natural contact shadows.
- Balanced exposure.
- Consistent lighting across all four panels.
- Clear visibility of fabric textures and construction details.

No dramatic lighting, cinematic color grading, harsh contrast, colored light effects, or heavy shadows.

---

## 11. IMAGE QUALITY & CONSISTENCY

Generate a photorealistic, ultra-clean, high-resolution character reference sheet.

Prioritize:

- Highly recognizable facial identity.
- Realistic skin texture.
- Detailed individual hair strands.
- Accurate anatomical proportions.
- Realistic hands and fingers.
- High-fidelity fabric textures and folds.
- Precise garment construction.
- Detailed footwear and accessories.
- Consistent color reproduction.
- Sharp, clean studio photography.

Avoid:

- Facial identity drift.
- Different-looking characters between panels.
- Inconsistent body proportions.
- Clothing changes.
- Missing or duplicated accessories.
- Distorted anatomy.
- Extra fingers or limbs.
- Incorrect garment details.
- Inconsistent lighting or camera perspective.
- Cropped body parts.
- Unnecessary creative interpretation.

---

## 12. ABSOLUTE FINAL PRIORITY

Follow this strict priority hierarchy:

1. **CHARACTER IDENTITY:** Preserve the exact recognizable character from the CHARACTER ASSET.
2. **OUTFIT & ACCESSORIES:** Reproduce the outfit and accessories from the OUTFIT / ACCESSORIES ASSET with maximum fidelity.
3. **NAIL DESIGN:** Preserve the NAIL ASSET accurately if provided.
4. **FIXED LAYOUT:** Exactly four equally sized panels in a 2×2 grid.
5. **CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:** The same character, body proportions, hairstyle, outfit, and accessories across all four panels.
6. **BODY PROPORTIONS:** Tall, slender, elongated, realistic anatomy with consistent front and rear dimensions.
7. **STUDIO PRESENTATION:** Neutral-gray background, standardized poses, soft lighting, and clean reference-sheet framing.
8. **NO INVENTION:** Do not add, remove, redesign, recolor, or creatively reinterpret referenced elements.

**FINAL OUTPUT:**

Generate ONE complete, photorealistic 2×2 character reference sheet containing exactly FOUR panels:

TOP LEFT: Front facial close-up.

TOP RIGHT: 90-degree side-profile facial close-up.

BOTTOM LEFT: Full-body front view.

BOTTOM RIGHT: Full-body rear view.

All four panels must represent ONE identical character wearing ONE identical outfit, faithfully assembled from the provided reference assets.

No captions, no panel labels, no added text, no watermark, no decorative graphics.

The final image must function as a reliable master character reference sheet for maintaining character identity, outfit accuracy, and body consistency in subsequent AI image and video generation."

nodes.prompt:
TASK: STRICT CHARACTER AND LIPSTICK PRODUCT REPLACEMENT WITH EXACT REFERENCE-VIDEO MOTION TRANSFER

REFERENCE INPUTS

IMAGE_1 = Authoritative replacement model reference.
IMAGE_2 = Authoritative lipstick product sheet.
VIDEO_1 = Original reference video and absolute source of motion, choreography, camera, environment, product animation, and timing.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVE

Reproduce VIDEO_1 as faithfully as possible while performing exactly TWO visual replacements:

1. Replace the original female model with the model from IMAGE_1.
2. Completely replace the original lipstick product with the exact lipstick from IMAGE_2.

Preserve the original actions, hand movements, product handling, floating lipstick animation, camera behavior, background, focus transitions, scene composition, and timing.

This is a STRICT VISUAL REPLACEMENT AND MOTION TRANSFER task.

It is NOT a creative video recreation.

REFERENCE PRIORITY

IMAGE_1 CONTROLS ONLY:
